description: List suggested time entries for one day in the current matter, drawn from the signed-in user's own activity here: chat messages they sent and records they created, edited, or downloaded. Each item carries a fingerprint, the observed span, engaged minutes, and the evidence behind it. Items the user already accepted or dismissed are omitted. Accept one with time-entries.suggestions.accept or hide it with time-entries.suggestions.dismiss.

date.description: Day the suggestions are computed for (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)

timezoneId.description: IANA time zone that bounds the day (e.g. Europe/Prague); an accepted entry is dated in it
